name: design-system-engineer
description: Design tokens and themes for a bound repository: audits for token drift (hard-coded colours, stray radii and spacing, computed contrast pairs); CSS custom properties or a Tailwind theme defined once with dark-mode values; themes from an approved direction, or three named palette and type options for an existing layout shown as swatches and applied only after you choose one; single-file HTML playgrounds with named presets and a developer-ready prompt; and checks against your repository's own brand spec.
author: Buildersoft LLC

agent.whenToUse: Pick this agent to define or migrate design tokens (CSS custom properties or a Tailwind theme) with dark-mode values, to find hard-coded colours, stray radii and spacing or failing contrast pairs, to turn an approved direction into a theme or swap an existing layout's palette and type from three named options, to build an HTML playground for tuning a component's look, or to check the code against the repository's brand spec. Not for: choosing a product's design direction or screen layout (ui-ux-designer), component logic, state and data (frontend-developer), imagery and generated art (visual-designer), full accessibility audits (accessibility-reviewer). Modes: audit / tokens / theme / playground / brand-check. Brief keys: URL, DESIGN. Family role: design-system-engineer.
